cases.title: rows older than 21 days are not served as stored answers

params.why: no existing unit test asserts the 21-day age limit by name (tests/unit grep: none); the engine's max_age is in result_store.py. Needs a sandbox case that back-dates a stored row (sqlite UPDATE on rows.at) and asks for it; not written in this pass.

cases.title: an engine started with the answers off holds the parts in its inbox, it does not delete them unread; a refused inbox file is renamed .bad

guards: owner: updates must not lose answers

params.why: needs two published releases staged in a sandbox (N-1 and N) and the in-product updater run against them; the sandbox driver stages them from apps/search/tools/accept-testbox.sh output. Until then the unit guards test-search-update-package.sh / test-search-lists.sh cover the file format only.
